floorPlans.note: All 32 options preserve complete original spreads and source notices, with separate original PDFs for Buildings 1 and 2. Each brochure contains 23 residence types. Paired figures describe separate homes. Loft totals include both levels and outdoor areas where printed. Final visible tables take precedence over masked underlying text. Examples include 1 BR J at 1,538 sq ft, 2 BR A at 1,255 sq ft, F at 1,142 sq ft and loft H at 2,234 sq ft. The area tables contain minor rounding differences. The original interior, pool and arts-district concepts accompany completed-building photographs and do not establish final unit finishes. Confirm the contracted unit and current drawing revision.

review.imagery: Root visually reviewed all14 original extracted brochure scenes and both April2026 completion photographs. Fourteen selected entries combine both completion photos with12 original building/interior/pool/community concepts. The card uses the official completed-building photograph. Both residence buildings and proposed arts-district context retain explicit scope. Architect portraits and generic lifestyle scenes excluded.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all32 complete original source spreads and all46 enlarged visible top numeric panels from both current brochures. Every residence type and building floor is represented. The earlier2024 index was reviewed for provenance and retained as an earlier cached source. Type J1538,2BR A1255/F1142/H2234 and other visible refinements override masked stale text in the selector. Both PDF originals and physical-page links preserved.
review.location: Root reviewed the separate Building1 and2 red footprint masters and both community maps. The map publishes2/3/5/20-minute community estimates. Exact entrance coordinates, kilometre journeys and live route conditions remain unverified. The completed residence complex is distinguished from the separately planned performing-arts centre.
review.provenance: Official original three-brochure receipts retain source URLs, dates, bytes and SHA256. The20April2026 developer completion article and both photographs have separate dated byte/hash receipts. No source artwork altered, access bypass or enquiry. Canonical researched records and protected identity preserved.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, exact kilometre journeys, current routing, contracted unit revision and final interior finishes remain unverified. Original plan tables contain rounding differences and masked stale text.
